'''Trap''', also identified as '''CL-9632''', was a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] who led [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[TB-73/Legends|supply ship]] being transported back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].

==Biography==
[[File:TrapDead-BI.png|thumb|left|200px|Trap lies dead after Barriss Offee was forced to kill him]]
After serving on Geonosis, several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of Tango Company were infected by [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]]. They were then sent on a mission to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] on a medical supply run. While stationed on the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] TB-73, the worms spread from clone trooper [[Scythe (clone trooper)|Scythe]] to infect the other clones and attempt to take over the ship. After Scythe ordered clone troopers Edge and Ox to attack the Jedi [[Padawan|Padawans]] Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee, Trap and another clone, [[Havoc (clone trooper)/Legends|Havoc]], heard the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots in the mess and rushed in to find the skirmish. The Jedi believed Trap and Havoc were also infected and ordered them to stand down. However, they successfully convinced the Jedi that they were not infected, and Trap volunteered Havoc to look after the now-unconscious Ox and Edge while the others headed to the bridge. Though they initially trusted him, it would soon be revealed to the Jedi that Trap, too, was infected by a brain worm. Trap attempted to kill Barriss Offee, but he was instead killed by her when she ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through his stomach. If not for his attack, the Jedi would not have known about the parasites.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Equipment==
[[File:TrapHS.png|thumb|200px|Trap's customized armor]]
Trap carried a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] carbine, and was featured wearing a backpack. He wore Phase I Armor with blue markings and bore a striped sigil on his chest plate that resembled a stylized tiger face.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
